title: WhatsApp pe AI agent kaise kaam karta hai?
hooks: WhatsApp pe ab bot nahi, asli AI agent chalta hai
Do billion log WhatsApp use karte hain, par reply kaun deta hai?
Chatbot se AI agent ka farak jaante ho?
hook_why: Direct claim with surprise - 'bot nahi, asli AI agent' challenges what viewers assume about WhatsApp automation. First 4 words carry the hook, colloquial Hinglish, zero filler.
metaphor: Universal Smart Switchboard: a glowing 3D neural hub at center with 4 pulsing spokes connecting to Calendar, CRM, Payment, Knowledge Base icons. Every incoming WhatsApp message hits the hub, which instantly routes to the right tool, remembers context, and replies in any language - like a super-intelligent telephone operator who never sleeps.

caption:
WhatsApp pe ab bot nahi, asli AI agent chalta hai 🤖

2 billion users, par businesses reply nahi kar paate. AI agent samajhta hai context, bhoolta nahi, 100+ bhasha bolta hai. Docs se khud train hota hai. Calendar, CRM, payment - sab handle karta hai ek message pe.
